name: Castelnou (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow chevron pointing to the fly from the hoist, charged at the hoist with a white castle between the letters C and N.
history: Municipal flag of Castelnou; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron issuing from the hoist and pointing to the fly
castle between the letters C and N
